name: Sayashi Juurou
source: Main character of the third route. A famous actor who is considered to be a treasure of Japan. He inherited the drama hero role "Taiyo Kamen Icarus" from his father. Talked about a lot and receives a lot of admiration. Regarded as an unwavering indicator of justice, but his true intention seems to be somewhere else. Also the leader of the Icarus squadron.
